Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps to make the security review easier for your team:

- HealthFit needs a vendor security questionnaire, SOC 2 report, and a short call with our security architect.
- Tight procurement timeline: preferred contract sign by end of June if we can clear the compliance checks.

Immediate next steps
1) I attached an editable vendor security questionnaire (VSA_healthfit_questionnaire.xlsx) — please complete and return; we can pre-fill items if helpful.
2) SOC 2: we can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II summary now (attached SOC2-summary-2025Q1.pdf). For full report we typically do an NDA + DPA.
3) Security call: propose Wed 5/13 09:00–10:00 PT for a technical Q&A with Rishi (sec architect) and Hannah (CS lead).
4) If HIPAA applies to your workflow, flag the flows and we’ll route to our compliance lead for a short intake.

Internal ask: CCed Rishi/Hannah — can you confirm availability for Wed 5/13 and whether we should route any escalations to Vivek for contractual exceptions?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite and a HubSpot link.

Subject: Internal: HealthFit compliance roadmap & recommended sequencing

Camila / Hannah / Vivek —

Notes from the call + recommended compliance sequencing for HealthFit (quick internal digest for sales/ops):

1) Short-term (0–6 weeks) — unblock procurement
- Share redacted SOC 2 Type II and confirm service IDs (tie to our SOC inventory). I can draft a 1-page mapping that calls out inference endpoints and storage buckets.
- Return VSA with answers and a column for evidence links (I’ll pre-populate evidence pointers to our internal Drive).
- Legal: provide NDA + BAA templates. Vivek, can you attach the current BAA and confirm any needed addenda for state-level privacy (CA/MA/NJ)?

2) Medium-term (6–16 weeks) — maturity items to satisfy enterprise buyers
- ISO 27001: run a gap assessment to produce a prioritized roadmap. Estimated 8–12 weeks to gap + remediation sprint for items affecting infra and processes.
- SOC scope expansion: if HealthFit requires additional services in scope (e.g., dedicated private deployment), expect a 3–6 month timeline to include that in the next SOC cycle.

3) Long-term (3–9 months) — regulated healthcare path
- FedRAMP: preliminary assessment required; substantial lift for JAB/Agency paths. Recommend a FedRAMP-light analysis only if HealthFit explicitly asks (this can add 9+ months).

Action items (who/when)
- Rishi: produce SOC mapping doc and pre-fill VSA evidence links (ETA 2 business days).
- Camila: follow up with legal contact for NDA/BAA and schedule the security call (you have invite pending).
- Vivek: share BAA template and confirm whether any state-level privacy addenda are standard (ETA 48 hours).
- Hannah: prepare a CS note on product isolation options (hosted vs dedicated) to help procurement decision (ETA 4 business days).

I’ll keep the language conservative on timelines when talking externally — give HealthFit a realistic path and surface tradeoffs for FedRAMP vs quicker ISO/SOC options.

Rishi Malhotra
Security Architect | Redwood Inference
